title: Great Powers Shake the Land
summary: Nangong Zheng, who reappeared because of the Bronze Immortal Palace, says the Ji family head promised him a disciple to carry on his legacy if he saved one of the siblings, and invites the Peacock King to enter the palace with him to seek immortality together rather than die alone. The Peacock King refuses, and their duel pits his 'Stars Shining in a Clear Sky' phenomenon against Nangong Zheng's 'Wooden Pillar Splitting the Sky', tearing up the land around Ye Fan and Ziyue. Drained and unable to use the Void technique herself, Ziyue teaches Ye Fan the complete Void technique so he can carry her out, even though the Ji family's curse on the secret art wounds her for passing it on. Elsewhere a black-robed agent reports to his Master that Ye Fan has the Ancient Holy Body. Ye Fan revives Ziyue with divine spring water, and she asks to be taken to her Great-Aunt Ji Hui. Pursued again, they are ambushed at Imperial Water Gorge just as Ji Ren of the Ji family, a Dao Palace cultivator, arrives.
